title: Poketod SMP
description: An optimized, full-feature Cobblemon modpack tailored for the Poketod SMP. Experience smooth gameplay, economy, and multiplayer adventures!
body:
# Poketod SMP
An official Cobblemon modpack made specifically for the Poketod SMP server.

This modpack delivers a pure, full-featured Pokémon adventure in Minecraft, focusing on deep exploration, multiplayer progression, and Quality of Life (QoL) improvements. Built entirely from the ground up, it is highly optimized to provide a smooth, lightweight experience without sacrificing gameplay depth.

## Features
* **Ultimate Cobblemon Adventure:** Packed with engaging addons including Raid Dens, Battle Towers, Ranked PvP, Secret Bases, Safari Zones, Pokémon Gyms and More.
* **Multiplayer & Economy:** Integrated Global Trade System (GTS) and CobbleDollars for a dynamic, player-driven economy.
* **Quality of Life (QoL):** Essential survival additions like Sophisticated Backpacks, Waystones, Lootr, and polished UI enhancements to make your journey comfortable.
* **Highly Optimized:** Carefully curated with top-tier performance mods (Lithium, FerriteCore, ModernFix, etc.) to ensure stable server TPS and smooth client FPS, even on lower-end machines.

## Additional Information

Mods Legendary Monuments is included in the modpack files for technical reasons but is disabled by default and is not used by the Poketod SMP server.

Some launchers may still detect or load Mods Legendary Monuments despite it being disabled. If this happens, simply remove the mods from your mods folder before launching the game.

## Required mods

Due to licensing restrictions, some mods are not included directly in this modpack distribution.
These mods required for full compatibility and server functionality on Poketod SMP:

* [FTB Library](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ftb-library-fabric/files/7746958)
* [FTB Essentials](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ftb-essentials/files/7608732)
